answer.rationale: p99 latency climbing 5x target during settlement peak indicates resource contention, not correctness fault. Rollback is ruled out (security patch must stay). Circuit breaker and regional failover are defensive; they reduce load but risk write loss during peak settlement. Adding capacity directly addresses the bottleneck—memory_b3 demonstrates that provisioning headroom before peaks absorbs surge traffic safely. Memory_b5 shows we can also selectively route non-transactional load away, but capacity addition is primary lever here. This preserves all customer writes while buying time to investigate root cause post-peak. Scale: standard_experiment applies headroom incrementally to validate it resolves latency without overshooting.
